newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - OpCo details Anheuser cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - OpCo details Anheuser cut.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Roy Burry confirmed his downgrade of Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc to market perform from buy, an item attributed earlier to market sources.
-- Burry said the cut was based on the stock's valuation and an expectation that the price of brewing commodities and aluminum will rise in the next year, pressuring the company's gross margins.

-- "The stock has done well and the story is totally visable. We are worried about pricing and raw material costs. Miller (Philip Morris Cos Inc's beer unit) is not going along with a price increase and brewing commodities and aluminum prices are looking like they are going up in 1997."
-- He trimmed the 1997 earnings estimate by $0.08 to $2.45 and the 12-month price target is $39 per share.
-- The stock was unchanged at 39-1/2, with a 12-month high of 40, and a 12-month low of 30-3/4.
